classes.title: Strategy Challenges
classes.baseRequirement: Complete the character’s story strategy trial and solve unique decisions
classes.use: Show a cosmetic attack animation or weapon pose in Kingdom practice scenes

classes.title: Story Discovery
classes.baseRequirement: Finish a unique story chapter and its exploration clue
classes.use: Open a non-credit lore vignette or memorial entry in the character journal

classes.title: Milestone Rewards
classes.baseRequirement: Complete a unique eligible Kingdom milestone; no repeated chest farming
classes.use: Open a visually themed celebration with deterministic cosmetic choice, never paid random prizes

classes.title: Gathering & Craft
classes.baseRequirement: Discover each region in a distinct exploration or crafting challenge
classes.use: Craft decorative items in the separate non-credit Kingdom workshop

classes.title: Practice Tools
classes.baseRequirement: Complete an introductory practice stage to study the item’s recipe
classes.use: Optional, time-limited effect in non-credit practice only; never official scoring

classes.title: Exploration Tools
classes.baseRequirement: Solve a route puzzle or scenario using different evidence
classes.use: Assist navigation or cosmetic exploration in story practice

classes.title: Collection Book
classes.baseRequirement: Claim distinct, verified chapter collectibles and finish themed pages
classes.use: Decorate a personal collection-book spread; no economic privileges

classes.title: Achievements & Identity
classes.baseRequirement: Finish verified unique achievements in their own category
classes.use: Equip profile or Kingdom character emblem with its title and visual

classes.title: Guardian Wardrobe
classes.baseRequirement: Finish a guardian-themed character challenge and a unique tier trial
classes.use: Equip as cosmetic armor, improving the look and practice effects only

classes.title: Relic Wardrobe
classes.baseRequirement: Complete a story mastery and a collection-page milestone
classes.use: Equip in character studio or profile styling

classes.title: Character Ascension
classes.baseRequirement: Reach the story milestone and finish the appropriate character gate
classes.use: Unlock a cosmetic evolution form and a new story scene in local character adventure

classes.title: Buklod Bonds
classes.baseRequirement: Choose meaningful dialogue paths and complete companion-specific co-op story tasks
classes.use: Travel with a companion avatar and open its non-credit dialogue scenes

classes.title: Practice Abilities
classes.baseRequirement: Prove skill in a unique story challenge of the matching category
classes.use: Optional practice-game ability or animation, not official Mastery advantages

classes.title: Workshop Materials
classes.baseRequirement: Gather unique crafting fragments from story exploration milestones
classes.use: Combine materials into cosmetic props in a server-authorized future workshop

classes.title: Kingdom Decorations
classes.baseRequirement: Finish a regional story arc and collection page
classes.use: Decorate a personal virtual Kingdom room; no real estate, money or investment value

classes.title: World Discovery
classes.baseRequirement: Complete an approved regional challenge and read its story clues
classes.use: Reveal non-credit map vignettes or optional exploration chapters

classes.title: Adventure Missions
classes.baseRequirement: Finish a distinct daily/story/team mission with verified completion
classes.use: Record a milestone in the quest journal and gain cosmetic chapter markers

classes.title: Season Showcase
classes.baseRequirement: Complete freely available seasonal missions within a published event
classes.use: Show cosmetic banner, title or season memory without expired paid prerequisites

classes.title: Legacy Journey
classes.baseRequirement: Complete a full character arc and its final non-credit challenge
classes.use: Display an Ascension form, monument or prestige profile visual

classes.title: Profile Identity
classes.baseRequirement: Earn unique story and collection achievements
classes.use: Equip visual borders, nameplates, pose or trail in allowed profile surfaces
